messages:
alex: Heads-up — Acme Health wants to expand the POC scope. They want Private deployment (VPC) + HIPAA controls, plus reranking over EHR notes. Need pricing impact & timeline. Anyone free to sync?

samir: On it. Quick Qs: do they require on-prem air-gapped, or cloud VPC? Also what's the target accuracy uplift for the reranker?

alex: They said 'customer-managed network (VPC) first choice', on-prem later maybe. Success criteria they gave: 95% top-1 precision on clinical QA eval set, end-to-end latency < 300ms for single-turn queries, and PHI must never leave their VPC. POC timeline initially 4 weeks.

maya: 300ms SLO is tight for Private with long context EHR notes (avg 8k tokens). We'll need to pick model + quantization carefully and tune KV cache. :thinking: Also multi-GPU or sharding likely.

carla: Security checklist: KMS integration + HSM optional, full audit logs, SOC2 + HIPAA BAA required. We need their completed security questionnaire and confirmation on PHI workflows. I'll start the BAA thread.

samir: For pricing, Dedicated vs Private is a big delta. Ballpark: Private VPC setup + infra/reserved nodes = ~2x baseline. I'll draft an updated SOW once we confirm infra. Do we have a sample VPC+KMS config to share?

maya: I can paste a minimal example and some sizing notes, but caveat: for 8k tokens and <300ms we'd probably want 80GB-class GPUs or a small sharded cluster. Snippet:
```
nodes:
  - type: gpu-a100-80g
    count: 2
network:
  vpc_peering: true
  kms: customer-kms
  private_endpoint: true
```

alex: Another change: customer wants vector DB integration (Milvus) for retrieval + rerank. That will add network hops; they expect sub-300ms end-to-end. Can we do a co-located embedding cache to reduce round-trips?

maya: Yes — colocated ANN cache + local embedding store helps a lot. If Milvus is inside their VPC, we'll need egress/peering rules and affinity so model and ANN are co-located. Perf tests need a realistic retrieval workload.

samir: Action items: 1) Maya — perf estimate + minimal infra config for 8k avg context + rerank. 2) Carla — confirm BAA/controls checklist, SSO/KMS acceptance, and any extra PHI requirements. 3) Alex — request eval corpus + sample queries from the customer and confirm Milvus deployment location. I'll update pricing and SOW after inputs. ETA EOD tomorrow? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

carla: I'll loop in legal for the BAA template and start the controls inventory. If they insist on on-prem air-gapped, that'll be a different pricing bucket and needs lead time.

alex: Sending note to the customer now to request corpus and confirm Milvus location. cc @ops-bot for ticket tracking. Thanks team.

ops-bot: New POC ticket created: POC-4567. Assigned to samir, maya.

samir: Got the ticket. I'll start drafting SOW + updated cost appendix. One more operational ask — include a canary/fallback plan to a smaller hosted model to preserve uptime if Private instances degrade.

alex: Good call, will include automatic fallback policy in the acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:

alex: Quick update — if customer moves to full on-prem, timeline will likely stretch to ~6 weeks and require an install window for their infra team. Noted for the proposal.
